verses.geez: ዘያፈቅር፡ ተግሣፀ፡ ያፈቅር፡ አእምሮ፡ ወዘይጸልእሰ፡ ተግሣፀ፡ ዓብድ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: He that loves instruction loves sense, but he that hates reproofs is a fool.

translations.lxx: He that loves instruction loves sense, but he that hates reproofs is a fool.
translations.kjv: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
translations.ron: Cel ce iubeşte învăţătura iubeşte ştiinţa, iar cel ce urăşte certarea este nebun.
translations.grk: Ὁ ἀγαπῶν παιδείαν, ἀγαπᾷ αἴσθησιν· ὁ δὲ μισῶν ἐλέγχους, ἄφρων.

verses.geez: ይኄይስ፡ ዘረከበ፡ ሞገሰ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወብእሲስ፡ ዓማፂ፡ ይትኄየይ።
verses.translation: He that has found favour with the Lord is made better; but a transgressor shall be passed over in silence.

translations.lxx: He that has found favour with the Lord is made better; but a transgressor shall be passed over in silence.
translations.kjv: A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
translations.ron: Cel bun dobândeşte har de la Domnul, iar pe omul viclean îl osândeşte Domnul.
translations.grk: Κρείσσων ὁ εὑρὼν χάριν παρὰ Κυρίῳ, ἀνὴρ δὲ παράνομος παρασιωπηθήσεται.

verses.geez: ዘኢያረትዕ፡ ሰብእ፡ እምዓመፃ፡ ይትኀጐል፡ ወሥርወ፡ ጻድቃንሰ፡ ኢይትመሐው።
verses.translation: A man shall not prosper by wickedness; but the roots of the righteous shall not be taken up.

translations.lxx: A man shall not prosper by wickedness; but the roots of the righteous shall not be taken up.
translations.kjv: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
translations.ron: Omul nu se întăreşte întru fărădelegea lui; rădăcina celor drepţi nu se va clătina niciodată.
translations.grk: Οὐ κατορθώσει ἄνθρωπος ἐξ ἀνόμου, αἱ δὲ ῥίζαι τῶν δικαίων οὐκ ἐξαρθήσονται.

verses.geez: ብእሲት፡ አዛዝ፡ አክሊል፡ ለምታ፡ ወከመ፡ ዕፄ፡ ለዕፅ፡ ከማሁ፡ ብእሲት፡ እኪተ፡ ምግባር፡ ታኀጒል፡ ልበ፡ ብእሲ።
verses.translation: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband; but as a worm in wood, so a bad woman destroys her husband.

translations.lxx: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband; but as a worm in wood, so a bad woman destroys her husband.
translations.kjv: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
translations.ron: Femeia virtuoasă este o cunună pentru bărbatul ei, iar femeia fără cinste este un cariu în oasele lui.
translations.grk: Γυνὴ ἀνδρεία στέφανος τῷ ἀνδρὶ αὐτῆς· ὥσπερ δὲ ἐν ξύλῳ σκώληξ, οὕτως ἄνδρα ἀπόλλυσι γυνὴ κακοποιός.

verses.geez: ሕሊናሆሙ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ ፍትሕ፡ ወይሔድፉ፡ ረሲዓን፡ ሕብለ።
verses.translation: The thoughts of the righteous are true judgments; but ungodly men devise deceits.

translations.lxx: The thoughts of the righteous are true judgments; but ungodly men devise deceits.
translations.kjv: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
translations.ron: Socotelile celor drepţi sunt dreptatea, iar punerile la cale ale celor nelegiuiţi înşelăciunea.
translations.grk: Λογισμοὶ δικαίων κρίματα, κυβερνῶσι δὲ ἀσεβεῖς δόλους.

verses.geez: ነገረ፡ ረሲዓን፡ ጒሕሉት፡ ወአፈ፡ ረሲዓንሰ፡ ታድኅኖሙ።
verses.translation: The words of ungodly men are crafty; but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

translations.lxx: The words of ungodly men are crafty; but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
translations.kjv: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
translations.ron: Graiurile celor nelegiuiţi sunt curse de moarte, iar gura celor drepţi îi scapă pe ei din primejdie.
translations.grk: Λόγοι ἀσεβῶν δόλιοι, στόμα δὲ ὀρθῶν ῥύσεται αὐτούς.

verses.geez: ኀበ፡ ተመይጠ፡ ረሲዕ፡ ይማስን፡ አብያተ፡ ጻድቃንሰ፡ ይሄልዉ።
verses.translation: When the ungodly is overthrown, he vanishes away; but the houses of the just remain.

translations.lxx: When the ungodly is overthrown, he vanishes away; but the houses of the just remain.
translations.kjv: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
translations.ron: Cei fără de lege numai cât se întorc şi nu mai sunt, dar casa drepţilor dăinuieşte de-a pururi.
translations.grk: Οὗ ἐὰν στραφῇ ὁ ἀσεβὴς, ἀφανίζεται, οἶκοι δὲ δικαίων παραμένουσι·

verses.geez: አፈ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ይትዌደስ፡ በኀበ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወእዩየ፡ ልብሰ፡ ይትሜነን።
verses.translation: The mouth of an understanding man is praised by a man; but he that is dull of heart is had in derision.

translations.lxx: The mouth of an understanding man is praised by a man; but he that is dull of heart is had in derision.
translations.kjv: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
translations.ron: Omul aste preţuit după priceperea lui, iar cel nepriceput este urgisit.
translations.grk: Στόμα συνετοῦ ἐγκωμιάζεται ὑπὸ ἀνδρὸς, νωθροκάρδιος δὲ μυκτηρίζεται.

verses.geez: ይኄይስ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘበኃሣሩ፡ ይትቀነይ፡ እምነ፡ ዘያነብር፡ ክብረ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወይትፈአም፡ ኅብስተ።
verses.translation: Better is a man in dishonour serving himself, than one honouring himself and wanting bread.

translations.lxx: Better is a man in dishonour serving himself, than one honouring himself and wanting bread.
translations.kjv: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
translations.ron: Mai mult preţuieşte un om smerit dar harnic, decât unul mândru dar lipsit de pâine.
translations.grk: Κρείσσων ἀνὴρ ἐν ἀτιμίᾳ δουλεύων ἑαυτῷ, ἢ τιμὴν ἑαυτῷ περιτιθεὶς καὶ προσδεόμενος ἄρτου.

verses.geez: ይምሕር፡ ጻድቅ፡ ነፍሰ፡ እንስሳሁ፡ ወምሕረቶሙሰ፡ ለረሲዓን፡ ኢ፡ ምጽዋት።
verses.translation: A righteous man has pity for the lives of his cattle; but the bowels of the ungodly are unmerciful.

translations.lxx: A righteous man has pity for the lives of his cattle; but the bowels of the ungodly are unmerciful.
translations.kjv: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
translations.ron: Cel drept are milă de vite, iar inima celui rău este fără îndurare.
translations.grk: Δίκαιος οἰκτείρει ψυχὰς κτηνῶν αὐτοῦ, τὰ δὲ σπλάγχνα τῶν ἀσεβῶν ἀνελεήμονα.

verses.geez: ዘይትጌበራ፡ ለምድር፡ ያበዝኅ፡ ኅብስተ፡ ወዘሰ፡ ይዴግን፡ ጽርዓተ፡ ያስተጋብእ፡ ንዴተ፡ እስመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ነዳየ፡ አእምሮ።
verses.translation: He that tills his own land shall be satisfied with bread; but they that pursue vanities are void of understanding.

translations.lxx: He that enjoys himself in banquets of wine, shall leave dishonour in his own strong holds.
translations.kjv: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
translations.ron: Cel ce munceşte ogorul său se satură de pâine, iar cel ce umblă după deşertăciuni este om lipsit de minte.
translations.grk: Ὁ ἐργαζόμενος τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γῆν, ἐμπλησθήσεται ἄρτων, οἱ δὲ διώκοντες μάταια, ἐνδεεῖς φρενῶν· ὅς ἐστιν ἡδὺς ἐν οἴνων διατριβαῖς, ἐν τοῖς ἑαυτοῦ ὀχυρώμασι καταλείψει ἀτιμίαν.

verses.geez: ዝ፡ ውእቱ፡ ምዑዝ፡ ለመትልወ፡ ወይን፡ ወበኀይለ፡ ዚአሁ፡ የኃድግ፡ ኃሣረ።
verses.translation: The desires of the ungodly are evil; but the roots of the godly are firmly set.

translations.lxx: The desires of the ungodly are evil; but the roots of the godly are firmly set.
translations.kjv: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
translations.ron: Nelegiuitul pofteşte prada celor răi, dar rădăcina celor drepţi dă rodul său.
translations.grk: Ἐπιθυμίαι ἀσεβῶν κακαὶ, αἱ δὲ ῥίζαι τῶν εὐσεβῶν ἐν ὀχυρώμασι.

verses.geez: ፍትወተ፡ ረሲዓን፡ እኪት፡ ወሥርዎሙሰ፡ ለኄራን፡ ውስተ፡ ጽንዕ።
verses.translation: For the sin of his lips a sinner falls into snares; but a righteous man escapes from them.

translations.lxx: He whose looks are gentle shall be pitied, but he that contends in the gates will afflict souls.
translations.kjv: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
translations.ron: Prin păcatul buzelor se prinde în laţ păcătosul, iar dreptul (prin dreptatea lui) scapă din strâmtorare.
translations.grk: Διʼ ἁμαρτίαν χειλέων ἐμπίπτει εἰς παγίδας ἁμαρτωλὸς, ἐκφεύγει δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν δίκαιος· ὁ βλέπων λεῖα ἐλεηθήσεται, ὁ δὲ συναντῶν ἐν πύλαις ἐκθλίψει ψυχάς.

verses.geez: በኃጢአተ፡ ከናፍሪሁ፡ ይወድቅ፡ ኃጥእ፡ ውስተ፡ መሥገርት፡ ወያመሥጥ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ጻድቅ።
verses.translation: The soul of a man shall be filled with good from the fruits of his mouth; and the recompence of his lips shall be given to him.

translations.lxx: The soul of a man shall be filled with good from the fruits of his mouth; and the recompence of his lips shall be given to him.
translations.kjv: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.
translations.ron: Din rodul gurii sale se satură de cele bune omul, şi fiecăruia i se răsplăteşte după faptele lui.
translations.grk: Ἀπὸ καρπῶν στόματος ψυχὴ ἀνδρὸς πλησθήσεται ἀγαθῶν, ἀνταπόδομα δὲ χειλέων αὐτοῦ δοθήσεται αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: ዘይኔጽር፡ ሰፉሐ፡ ይትሜሀር፡ ወዘሰ፡ ይዳደቅ፡ በአናቅጽ፡ ያመነድብ፡ ነፍሳተ።
verses.translation: The ways of fools are right in their own eyes; but a wise man hearkens to counsels.

translations.lxx: The ways of fools are right in their own eyes; but a wise man hearkens to counsels.
translations.kjv: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
translations.ron: Calea celui nebun este dreaptă în ochii lui, iar cel înţelept ascultă de sfat.
translations.grk: Ὁδοὶ ἀφρόνων ὀρθαὶ ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν, εἰσακούει δὲ συμβουλίας σοφός.

verses.geez: እምፍሬ፡ አፉሁ፡ ነፍሰ፡ ብእሲ፡ ይመልእ፡ በረከተ፡ ወዕሤተ፡ ከናፍሪሁ፡ ይትወሀብ፡ ሎቱ።
verses.translation: A fool declares his wrath the same day; but a prudent man hides his own disgrace.

translations.lxx: A fool declares his wrath the same day; but a prudent man hides his own disgrace.
translations.kjv: A fool’s wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
translations.ron: Nebunul dă pe faţă îndată mânia lui, iar omul prevăzător îşi ascunde ocara.
translations.grk: Ἄφρων αὐθημερὸν ἐξαγγέλλει ὀργὴν αὐτοῦ, κρύπτει δὲ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ἀτιμίαν ἀνὴρ πανοῦργος.

verses.geez: ፍኖተ፡ ዓብዳን፡ ርቱዕ፡ በቅድሜሆሙ፡ ወይሰምዕ፡ ምክረ፡ ዕዝነ፡ ጠቢብ።
verses.translation: A righteous man declares the open truth; but an unjust witness is deceitful.

translations.lxx: A righteous man declares the open truth; but an unjust witness is deceitful.
translations.kjv: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
translations.ron: Cel ce spune adevărul vesteşte dreptatea, iar martorul mincinos umblă cu înşelăciunea.
translations.grk: Ἐπιδεικνυμένην πίστιν ἀπαγγέλλει δίκαιος, ὁ δὲ μάρτυς τῶν ἀδίκων δόλιος.

verses.geez: ዓብድ፡ እንተ፡ ጸብሐት፡ ይነግር፡ መዓቶ፡ ማእምርሰ፡ የኀብእ፡ ኃሣሮ።
verses.translation: Some wound as they speak, like swords; but the tongues of the wise heal.

translations.lxx: Some wound as they speak, like swords; but the tongues of the wise heal.
translations.kjv: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
translations.ron: Cei nechibzuiţi la vorbă sunt ca împunsăturile de sabie, pe când limba celor înţelepţi aduce tămăduire.
translations.grk: Εἰσὶν οἳ λέγοντες τιτρώσκουσι, μάχαιραι· γλῶσσαι δὲ σοφῶν ἰῶνται.

verses.geez: እንተ፡ ታስተርኢ፡ ሃይማኖተ፡ ይነግር፡ ብእሲ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ወሰማዕተ፡ እኩያንሰ፡ ሕብል።
verses.translation: True lips establish testimony; but a hasty witness has an unjust tongue.

translations.lxx: True lips establish testimony; but a hasty witness has an unjust tongue.
translations.kjv: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
translations.ron: Buzele care spun adevărul vor dăinui totdeauna, iar limba grăitoare de minciună numai pentru o clipă.
translations.grk: Χείλη ἀληθινὰ κατορθοῖ μαρτυρίαν, μάρτυς δὲ ταχὺς γλῶσσαν ἔχει ἄδικον.

verses.geez: እለሰ፡ ይከውኑ፡ ስምዐ፡ በሐሰት፡ ይቀትሉ፡ በመጥባሕት፡ እስመ፡ ንቡር፡ ውስተ፡ አፉሆሙ፡ መጥባሕት፡ ወልሳነ፡ ጠቢባንሰ፡ ይፌውስ፡ ዘቈስለ።
verses.translation: There is deceit in the heart of him that imagines evil; but they that love peace shall rejoice.

translations.lxx: There is deceit in the heart of him that imagines evil; but they that love peace shall rejoice.
translations.kjv: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
translations.ron: Înşelăciunea este în inima celor ce gândesc rău, iar bucuria pentru cei ce dau sfaturi de pace.
translations.grk: Δόλος ἐν καρδίᾳ τεκταινομένου κακὰ, οἱ δὲ βουλόμενοι εἰρήνην εὐφρανθήσονται.

verses.geez: ከናፍረ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ያረትዓ፡ ስምዐ፡ ወሰማዕት፡ ጒጒዕ፡ በልሳን፡ እኩይ።
verses.translation: No injustice will please a just man; but the ungodly will be filled with mischief.

translations.lxx: No injustice will please a just man; but the ungodly will be filled with mischief.
translations.kjv: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
translations.ron: Nici o nenorocire nu se întâmplă celui drept, pe când cei nelegiuiţi sunt covârşiţi de rele.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἀρέσει τῷ δικαίῳ οὐδὲν ἄδικον, οἱ δὲ ἀσεβεῖς πλησθήσονται κακῶν.

verses.geez: ሕብል፡ ውስተ፡ ልቡ፡ ለዘይሔሊ፡ እኩየ፡ ወእለሰ፡ ይፈቅዱ፡ ሰላመ፡ ይትፌሥሑ።
verses.translation: Lying lips are an abomination to the Lord; but he that deals faithfully is accepted with him.

translations.lxx: Lying lips are an abomination to the Lord; but he that deals faithfully is accepted with him.
translations.kjv: Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight.
translations.ron: Buzele cele grăitoare de minciună sunt urâciune înaintea Domnului, iar cei ce făptuiesc după adevăr sunt plăcerea Lui.
translations.grk: Βδέλυγμα Κυρίῳ χείλη ψευδῆ, ὁ δὲ ποιῶν πίστεις δεκτὸς παρʼ αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: ኢያሠምሮ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ ምንትኒ፡ እኩይ፡ ወረሲዓንሰ፡ ያበዝኁ፡ እከየ።
verses.translation: An understanding man is a throne of wisdom; but the heart of fools shall meet with curses.

translations.lxx: An understanding man is a throne of wisdom; but the heart of fools shall meet with curses.
translations.kjv: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
translations.ron: Omul înţelept îşi ascunde ştiinţa, pe când inima celor nebuni propovăduieşte nebunia.
translations.grk: Ἀνὴρ συνετὸς θρόνος αἰσθήσεως, καρδία δὲ ἀφρόνων συναντήσεται ἀραῖς.

verses.geez: ምኑናት፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ከናፍረ፡ ሐሰት፡ ወዘይገብርሰ፡ ሃይማኖተ፡ ሥሙር፡ በኀቤሁ።
verses.translation: The hand of chosen men shall easily obtain rule; but the deceitful shall be for a prey.

translations.lxx: The hand of chosen men shall easily obtain rule; but the deceitful shall be for a prey.
translations.kjv: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
translations.ron: Mâna celor silitori va stăpâni, iar cea lăsătoare va fi birnică.
translations.grk: Χεὶρ ἐκλεκτῶν κρατήσει εὐχερῶς, δόλιοι δὲ ἔσονται ἐν προνομῇ.

verses.geez: ብእሲ፡ ማእምር፡ መንበረ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወልበ፡ ዓብዳንሰ፡ ይዳደቅ፡ መርገመ።
verses.translation: A terrible word troubles the heart of a righteous man; but a good message rejoices him.

translations.lxx: A terrible word troubles the heart of a righteous man; but a good message rejoices him.
translations.kjv: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
translations.ron: Supărarea se abate asupra omului, dar numai un cuvânt bun îl bucură.
translations.grk: Φοβερὸς λόγος καρδίαν ταράσσει ἀνδρὸς δικαίου, ἀγγελία δὲ ἀγαθὴ εὐφραίνει αὐτόν.

verses.geez: እደ፡ ኅሩያን፡ ይእኅዝ፡ ፍጡነ፡ ወሕቡላንሰ፡ ይከውኑ፡ ለፂዋዌ።
verses.translation: A just arbitrator shall be his own friend; but mischief shall pursue sinners; and the way of ungodly men shall lead them astray.

translations.lxx: A just arbitrator shall be his own friend; but mischief shall pursue sinners; and the way of ungodly men shall lead them astray.
translations.kjv: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
translations.ron: Dreptul cercetează cu de-amănuntul pe prietenul său; calea celor nelegiuiţi duce la rătăcire.
translations.grk: Ἐπιγνώμων δίκαιος ἑαυτοῦ φίλος ἔσται, ἁμαρτάνοντας δὲ καταδιώξεται κακὰ, ἡ δὲ ὁδὸς τῶν ἀσεβῶν πλανήσει αὐτούς.

verses.geez: መደንግፅ፡ ቃል፡ የሀውከ፡ ልበ፡ ብእሲ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ወዜና፡ ሠናይሰ፡ ያስተፌሥሕ፡ ልበ፡ ብእሲ፡ ጠቢብ።
verses.translation: A deceitful man shall catch no game; but a blameless man is a precious possession.

translations.lxx: A deceitful man shall catch no game; but a blameless man is a precious possession.
translations.kjv: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
translations.ron: Leneşul nu-şi frige nici vânatul lui; cea mai scumpă comoară pentru om este munca.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἐπιτεύξεται δόλιος θήρας, κτῆμα δὲ τίμιον ἀνὴρ καθαρός.

verses.geez: ማእምረ፡ ርእሱ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ውእቱ፡ ለርእሱ፡ ወግዕዞሙሰ፡ ለረሲዓን፡ አኮ፡ አዳም።
verses.translation: In the ways of righteousness is life; but the ways of those that remember injuries lead to death.

translations.lxx: In the ways of righteousness is life; but the ways of those that remember injuries lead to death.
translations.kjv: In the way of righteousness is life: and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
translations.ron: Pe cărarea dreptăţii este viaţa şi pe calea pe care ea o însemnează; nemurirea, iar calea nebuniei duce la moarte.
translations.grk: Ἐν ὁδοῖς δικαιοσύνης ζωὴ, ὁδοὶ δὲ μνησικάκων εἰς θάνατον.

verses.geez: ለአላ፡ ይኤብሱ፡ ይዴግኖሙ፡ እኩይ፡ ወፍኖቶሙሰ፡ ለረሲዓን፡ ታስሕቶሙ።
ይዳደቅ፡ ሕብል፡ ለአስግሮ፡ ጥሪት፡ ወክቡር፡ ብእሲ፡ ንጹሕ።
ውስተ፡ ፍናወ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ሕይወት፡ ወእለሰ፡ ይዜከሩ፡ እኩየ፡ ውስተ፡ ሞት፡ ይሄልዉ።
